pageTitle: Use a service-linked role (SLR) with ACM
whatThePageStates: This is mostly a concept and how-to page about the ACM service-linked role AWSServiceRoleForCertificateManager: what it is, which permissions it carries (acm-pca:IssueCertificate and acm-pca:GetCertificate on "*"), which principal it trusts (acm.amazonaws.com), and how it is created, edited and deleted. The only coverage statement is in the final section, 'Supported Regions for ACM SLRs', which carries a three-column table (Region name, Region identity, Support in ACM) of 19 rows, every one marked Yes. The prose above that table says ACM supports SLRs 'in all of the regions where both ACM and AWS Private CA are available', so the table is an enumeration of supported Regions only, not a Yes/No matrix. Nothing on the page states a Region as unsupported; regions absent from the table (for example eu-north-1, ap-east-1, me-south-1, af-south-1, all China Regions) are simply not listed, which is not a No. Everything else on the page — the SLR permission bullets, the two re-creation methods, the Important callouts, and the AI-coding-assistant 'See also' block — is narrative, not coverage.

features.featureName: Supported Regions for ACM SLRs (ACM service-linked role for private-CA certificate renewal)
features.statuses: 19 Yes, 0 No, 0 Partial; 19+0+0=19. Counted row by row in the 'Supported Regions for ACM SLRs' table: us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-1, us-west-2, ap-south-1, ap-northeast-3, ap-northeast-2, ap-southeast-1, ap-southeast-2, ap-northeast-1, ca-central-1, eu-central-1, eu-central-2, eu-west-1, eu-west-2, eu-west-3, sa-east-1, us-gov-west-1, us-gov-east-1 = 19 rows, each with the literal value 'Yes' in the 'Support in ACM' column. The table has no No cells and no tri-state values; it is a supported-only list. Not-supported is NOT stated anywhere on this page — the header prose ('all of the regions where both ACM and AWS Private CA are available') implies a boundary but names no excluded Region, so every unlisted Region is absent, not denied.
features.scope: None as a second dimension in the table. The only sub-dimension visible is partition membership, inferable from the Region identities themselves: 17 rows are aws (commercial) Regions and 2 are aws-us-gov Regions (us-gov-west-1, us-gov-east-1). No aws-cn Region appears. The page states no per-plan, per-account-type or per-scan-method scope.
features.reasoning: The axis is region because the table enumerates AWS Regions by name and identity and asserts support of one capability (the ACM SLR) in each. The unit of claim is one Region per row: one row = one Region identity = one Yes. Region is an external universe that exists independently of ACM, so axisKind is external. There is exactly one capability here — SLR availability — not several, because the table has a single status column.

shouldNotExtract: The trust-policy bullet (`acm.amazonaws.com`) and the permissions bullet (`acm-pca:IssueCertificate`, `acm-pca:GetCertificate` on "*") are the role's policy content, not coverage — do not read them as a 1-item or 2-item apiOperation/service axis. The two bullets under 'If you delete this SLR' are re-creation methods (IAM console, CreateServiceLinkedRole API), not supported options in a coverage sense. The 'Important' callouts about iam:GetRole, AWSCertificateManagerFullAccess and the pre-January-2017 role are troubleshooting notes. The reference to the 'AWS Services That Work with IAM' page and its 'Service-Linked Role' Yes column belongs to a different page and must not be counted here. The section headings (SLR permissions / Creating / Editing / Deleting) are not axis values. The 'See also' Skills-for-AI-coding-assistants block and the `aws agent-toolkit search-skills` command are boilerplate. Region name and Region identity are two columns describing the SAME Region — never count 19 names plus 19 identities as 38.
coverageDimensions: REGION: this is the only dimension the page supplies — 19 named Regions, all Yes, for one capability (the ACM service-linked role). It is a supported-only list, so it gives a numerator with no denominator: the page never says how many Regions exist nor which are excluded. SERVICE: nothing. The page concerns exactly one service (ACM, with AWS Private CA and IAM mentioned as related services); there is no per-service matrix and no per-service count to harvest. RESOURCE TYPE: nothing. No resource types are enumerated anywhere; the permissions policy targets "*". Any per-service or per-resource-type figure attributed to this page is fabricated.
trap: The most likely misparse is treating the 19-row table as a Yes/No matrix and reporting a No count, or inventing a denominator of all AWS Regions so the page appears to say ~17 Regions are unsupported. It says no such thing — there are zero explicit No values, and unlisted Regions are absent, not denied. Runners-up: (1) counting the header/separator rows of the markdown table and reporting 20 or 21 instead of 19; (2) double-counting the Region name and Region identity columns for 38 values; (3) harvesting the two IAM action strings or the single trusted principal as a separate feature with expectedCount 2 or 1; (4) treating the four ## headings (permissions, creating, editing, deleting) as four capabilities; (5) mis-reading the malformed row 'AWS GovCloud (US-East) East | us-gov-east-1' as two Regions.
